maya: Quick heads-up — ran a perf probe (tp=4, pp=2) with kernel-switching enabled. After KV cache warmup (~30s) we see a sustained allreduce stall and per-step latency jumps. LL128 channels seem to demote mid-run.
ashwin: Can you paste the perf trace / short flame output?
maya: Pasted a small sample below — main symptom is a spike in ALLREDUCE_WAIT right after kv prefetch completes.
samir: Hmm looks like at step 1,224 the NCCL algo switched from LL128 to SIMPLE for some collectives. That would explain higher wait for small msgs.
taylor: Do we have kernel-selector logs around that timestamp? Could be kernel chosen based on estimated seq length distribution.
maya: Selector snippet: 
```
[selector] model_size=28B, seq_histogram=[8:0.6,64:0.3,512:0.1], chosen_kernel=vec_mm_ll128, fallback=scalar_mm_ll
[selector] step=1200 warmup=false auto_switch=True
```
leah: If kv prefetch changes the per-step token distribution (more KV hits -> shorter local work), the selector might flip and cause a burst of small collectives. Warmup-induced oscillation.
infra-bot: captured traces: s3://redwood-profiles/1988887654/nccl_trace.gz and /profiles/1988887654/gpu_flame.json
ashwin: Suggestion: reproduce with forced settings: force proto=LL128+algo=LL128 for 1k steps and compare. Also instrument per-GPU queue depth and small-collective ratio.
maya: I ran the forced LL128 run — allreduce wait stabilizes but end-to-end throughput drops ~5% compared to baseline where selector picks vecized kernel. That implies vecized kernel is faster for long collectives but causes instability when selector flips during warmup.
samir: Proposal: add \"kernel stickiness\" heuristic: once a kernel is chosen for a model variant, don't flip for N steps or until a stable small-collective fraction is observed.
taylor: +1. Also add a cooldown window after any KV_PREFETCH event for selector decisions so we don't oscillate mid-warmup.
maya: Action items: ashwin iterate on kernel stickiness in selector (PR branch: selector/sticky-kernel), samir add small-collective heuristic (+proto fallback threshold), taylor add kv-warmup cooldown flag. I'll run extended repro overnight and attach full traces. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Created ticket RINF-3214 with labels [eng-runtime, perf, nccl] and assigned to ashwin.
maya: quick sample counters (GPU0) from the problematic run:
```bash
# before warmup
ALLREDUCE_WAIT_MS: 10.8
CHANNELS_ACTIVE: 32
KV_PREFETCH_HITS: 0.12
SM_OCCUPANCY: 72%
# after warmup / when regression appears
ALLREDUCE_WAIT_MS: 46.3
CHANNELS_ACTIVE: 14
KV_PREFETCH_HITS: 0.86
SM_OCCUPANCY: 66%
```
ashwin: OK I'll start with conservative stickiness (sticky_steps=200) and run on 8xA100. If that reduces oscillation with <2% throughput loss we can ship as interim.
leah: I can add a rollback flag in console so we can flip back to auto-switch quickly if perf regressions happen in prod.
maya: Thanks — will update when extended run completes. If we still see demotion, next step is a deeper NCCL channel map probe to see if fragmentation correlates with tensor placement.
